Register Birth.description: Sends a birth notification from a facility or EMR to the Births and Deaths Registry.
Register Birth.code:
// Register a birth with the BDR. Auth (token exchange) is handled for you.
post('/api/v1/UserManagementService/integrations/registrations/birth', {
  status: 'COMPLETE', // or 'DRAFT'
  region_id: $.data.regionId, // coded ids from the utility lookup
  district_id: $.data.districtId,
  type_of_birth: 'SINGLETON',
  informant_type: 'MOTHER',
  informant_first_name: $.data.mother.firstName,
  informant_last_name: $.data.mother.lastName,
  informant_phone_number: $.data.mother.phone,
  child_first_name: $.data.child.firstName,
  child_last_name: $.data.child.lastName,
  child_gender: $.data.child.sex, // 'MALE' | 'FEMALE'
  child_dob: $.data.child.dateOfBirth, // YYYY-MM-DD
  child_place_of_birth: 'HOSPITAL',
  child_birth_attendant: 'MID-WIFE',
  child_birth_institution: $.data.facilityName,
  mother_first_name: $.data.mother.firstName,
  mother_last_name: $.data.mother.lastName,
  mother_national_id_type: 'GHANA CARD',
  mother_national_id_number: $.data.mother.ghanaCardNumber,
});

Update Birth Record.description: Updates an existing birth registration, e.g. to complete a draft once the father's details are known.

Register Death.description: Sends a death notification, e.g. from a hospital system, to the Births and Deaths Registry.
Register Death.code:
// Register a death with the BDR.
post('/api/v1/UserManagementService/integrations/registrations/death', {
  status: 'COMPLETE',
  service_type: 'EARLY_DEATH', // or 'LATE_DEATH'
  region_id: $.data.regionId,
  district_id: $.data.districtId,
  informant_type: $.data.informant.type, // a value from the INFORMANT_TYPE lookup
  informant_first_name: $.data.informant.firstName,
  informant_last_name: $.data.informant.lastName,
  informant_phone_number: $.data.informant.phone,
  deceased_first_name: $.data.deceased.firstName,
  deceased_last_name: $.data.deceased.lastName,
  deceased_gender: $.data.deceased.sex,
  deceased_age: $.data.deceased.age,
  deceased_age_unit: 'YEARS',
  deceased_date_of_death: $.data.dateOfDeath, // YYYY-MM-DD (required)
  death_institution: $.data.facilityName,
  examiner_cause_of_death: $.data.causeOfDeath,
});

Get Birth Record.description: Looks up a birth registration and its status by document number.
Get Birth Record.code:
// Look up a birth record (and its registration status).
get(`/api/v1/UserManagementService/integrations/registrations/birth/${$.data.documentNumber}`);

Get Death Record.description: Looks up a death registration and its status by document number.
Get Death Record.code:
// Look up a death record (and its registration status).
get(`/api/v1/UserManagementService/integrations/registrations/death/${$.data.documentNumber}`);

Get Districts For Region.description: Fetches the coded district list for a region, to map facility locations to BDR ids.
